## DiscVault

DiscVault is a standalone iPhone and iPad application for cataloguing physical film and TV collections. It supports 4K UHD, Blu-ray and DVD releases.

- Official product page: https://flux76.app/discvault/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/discvault/id6788772918
- DiscVault website: https://discvault.eu/
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad
- Minimum operating system: iOS 17.0 or iPadOS 17.0
- App Store category: Entertainment
- Price: Free
- Current verified version: 26.7.1
- Bundle identifier: eu.discvault.app
- Developer and publisher: Flux76

### Core capabilities

- Scan a disc barcode to retrieve film metadata and cover art.
- Catalogue 4K UHD, Blu-ray and DVD editions.
- Search and filter by title, genre, director and format.
- Run as a standalone app without a DiscVault server.
- Use the app without an account, advertising or third-party tracking.

## Colors of the Day

Colors of the Day is a daily colour memory game for iPhone. It is in development and available as a public beta on TestFlight: https://testflight.apple.com/join/hN7d5dkp

- Official product page: https://flux76.app/colors-of-the-day/
- Privacy policy: https://flux76.app/colors-of-the-day/privacy/ (Dutch: https://flux76.app/colors-of-the-day/privacy/nl/)
- Platform: iPhone
- Status: public beta on TestFlight (https://testflight.apple.com/join/hN7d5dkp); no App Store listing yet
- Developer and publisher: Flux76

### How it works

- Every day, all players get the same five colours.
- Each colour is shown full screen for 5, 4, 3, 2 and then 1 second across the five rounds.
- The player recreates each colour from memory with a colour picker (hue, saturation and brightness), without numbers or hex codes.
- A split circle reveals the target colour on the left and the player's choice on the right.
- Each round scores 0 to 100 points, up to 500 a day. A game takes about two minutes.
- Results are shared as a language-free image with only numbers and colours.
- The daily puzzle and sharing are free. There is no advertising.
- No account, no advertising, no tracking. Game history, streak and settings stay on the device.
- After a finished day the app sends only the day's total, the day number and a random install code to Flux76's server (Supabase, region Ireland) to show how the score compares with other players. Signed-in Game Center players also send the daily score and best streak to Apple's leaderboards.
